title: Signature Parts Vault Cabinet — Vault concept
description: The Signature Parts Vault Cabinet is Manon's original storage design: a 64-drawer cabinet where every drawer has an address and the index lives on the door — and in the Vault's memory. Parts do not get lost; they get filed.
